sanskrit: lokānāmiṣṭadātā'bhayalasitakaraḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārīvāṇī tasyānanābje vilasati satataṃ jñānasandohalakṣmīḥvāyormaṇḍalamatra dhūmasadṛśaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaśobhānvitampāṇibhyāmabhayaṃ varañca dadhataṃ lokatrayāṇāmapimattā pūrṇasudhārasārdrahṛdayā kaṅkālamālādharāmaulau sūkṣmavibhedayuṅmaṇiriva prollāsalakṣmyālayaḥvācāmīśvara īśvaro'pi jagatāṃ rakṣāvināśakṣamaḥlakṣmī raṅgaṇadaivataṃ parapure śaktaḥ praveṣṭuṃ kṣaṇāthimacchāyānāgopari lasitatanoḥ śuklavarṇāmbarasyasadāpūrvo devaḥ śiva iti ca samākhyānasiddhiprasiddhaḥmahāmokṣadvāraṃ śriyamabhi mataśīlasya śuddhendriyasyaścirañjīvī jīvī niravadhivipadāṃ dhvaṃsahaṃsaprakāśaḥvidyāṃ mudrāṃ kapālaṃ ḍamarujapavatīṃ bibhratī śubhracittāvedānāmādibījaṃ sthiratarahṛdayaścintayettat krameṇadīrghāyuḥ so'pi kartā tribhuvanabhavane saṃhṛtau pālane castadādye nādo'sau rasadhavalasudhādhārasantānahāsīstatastanmadhyāntaḥ pravilasitarūpānapi padān'vyayaḥ sākṣī vahneḥ śaśimihirayormaṇḍala ivapurāṇaṃ yogīndraḥ praviśati ca vedāntaviditamstadā vācāṃ siddhiḥ karatalakamale tasya bhūyāt sadaivalalāṭādyairvarṇaiḥ parilasitavapuḥkevalānandarūpamtadantaḥ śūnyaṃ tat sakalasuragaṇaiḥ sevitañcātiguhyamsvarūpī sarvātmā rasavirasamito'jñānamohāndhahaṃsaḥparīvāho haṃsaḥ parama iti nāmnā paricitaḥmunīndrā apyanye prakṛtipuruṣasthānamamalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadā kartuṃ hartuṃ khagatirapi vāṇī suvimalāpūrṇānandaparamparātivigalatpīyūṣadhārādharācandrārddhāṅgasamānabhaṅguravatī sarvārkatulyaprabhāsarveṣāṃ jīvabhūtā munimanasi mudā tattvabodhaṃ vahantīkeciddhaṃsākhyametat kimapi sukṛtino mokṣavartmaprabodhambhittvā talliṅgarūpaṃ pavanadahanayorākrameṇaiva taptāmmokṣākhyānandarūpaṃ ghaṭayati sahasā sūkṣmatālakṣaṇenayogīśo gurupādapadmayugalālambī samādhau yataḥyogī yogaparamparāviditayā brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍe sthitampūrṇānandaparamparāpramuditaḥ śāntaḥ satāmagraṇīḥstasyāvaśyamabhīṣṭadaivatapade ceto narīnṛtyateyogavivaraṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ prakāśaḥhastamātramitaṃ sūtraṃ parito lāñchayettataḥcaturasraṃ bhavet kuṇḍaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakamnyasettasyā nyaset sūtre pārśvayormadhyamāvadhipṛthak pṛthag yathā samyak tathā koṇatrayāvadhiuttarābhimukhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ yonyākhyaṃ siddhidāyakamtrikoṇakuṇḍamākhyātaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakamtadā vṛttaṃ bhavet kuṇḍaṃ prācīmukhamanuttamamekamekaṃ tato dadyād vāmadakṣiṇakoṇayoḥtanmadhyādūrddhvamānāntaṃ sūtramekaṃ nipātya cayāmye tanmāraṇe śastamuttarābhimukhaṃ sadāmadhyād vṛttatrayaṃ kuryādādyabhāge tu karṇikāmtadbāhye'ṣṭadalāgrāṇi kalpayeddeśikottamaḥadhobhāge keśarāṇi padmakuṇḍaṃ samīritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcadaśāṅgulaṃ khātaṃ ramaṇīyantu kārayetkuṇḍānāṃ yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ mekhalānāñca tādṛśamdaśahastāntamanyeṣāmarddhāṅgulaṃ pṛthak pṛthaktadbāhya-mekhalotsedhamaṅguladvitayaṃ bhavetvedāgnipakṣavistārāḥ kartavyā mekhalāḥ śubhāḥkartavyamathavā khātaṃ dvādaśāṅgulasammitamucchritā mekhalāḥ sarvāścaturaṅgulavistṛtāḥkhanet ṣaḍaṅgulotsedhā mekhalā vedavistṛtāathavā sarvakuṇḍaṃ hi khaneddhastaikamānataḥyāvat kuṇḍasya vistāraḥ khananaṃ tāvadīritamathavā tritayī kāryā vedāgninayanāṅgulaiḥuttamā madhyamā nyūnā krameṇa parikīrtitāḥaratrimātrakuṇḍe tu tri-dvyekāṅgulasaṃyutāḥmekhalā dvikare kuṇḍe rasa-vedaguṇāṅgulāḥdaśāṣṭāṅgāṅgulairjñeyā rasahaste tu mekhalāḥutsedhāyāmato jñeyā mekhalāḥ sarvato budhaiḥaśvatthapatrarūpāṃ vā trikoṇāṃ vā vicakṣaṇaḥekāṅgulantu yonyagraṃ kuryādīṣadadhomukhamekaikāṅgulato yoniṃ kuṇḍeṣvanyeṣu varddhayetdvādaśāṅguladīrghāntu tathāṣṭāṅgulavistṛtāmdaśahastāntakaṃ mānaṃ pūrvavad varddhayet kramāttridvyekāṅgulavistāraṃ kramānmūlāgramiṣyatemuṣṭyaratnekahastānāṃ nābhirutsedhabhāvataḥyavadvayakrameṇaiva nābhiṃ pṛthagudāradhīḥyonikuṇḍe tyajed yonimabje nābhiṃ vivarjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: patrāṇi vilikhedaṣṭau bahiraṃśadvaye sudhīḥhastamātraṃ sahasre tu dvihastamayute tathāsamantād varddhayettena kuṇḍaṃ tat syāddvihastakamevameva vidhānena tat sarvaṃ varddhayet sudhīḥatha toḍalatantrasya matamanyat pracakṣyatevarddhayettena mānena dvihastañca pracakṣyateaṣṭahastaṃ koṭihome daśahastaṃ tathaiva calakṣāṇāṃ daśakaṃ yāvattāvaddhastena varddhayetdaśahastāt paraṃ kuṇḍaṃ nāsti sarvāgameṣvapivakrakuṇḍe tu santāpo maraṇaṃ chinnamekhalekuṇḍasya rūpaṃ jānīyāt paramaṃ prakṛtervapuḥudaraṃ kuṇḍamityuktaṃ yoniḥ pādau ca paścimeyonikuṇḍaṃ vākpradaṃ syādākṛṣṭikaraṇaṃ bhagampadmākhyaṃ sarvasampatteḥ kāraṇaṃ puṣṭidaṃ bhavetvaṇijāmarddhacantrañca tryasrantu śūdrajanmanāmācāryāḥ kathayantyeke sarveṣāṃ caturasrakamapatyadhvaṃsanaṃ proktaṃ kuṇḍaṃ yat kaṇṭhavarjitamnityaṃ naimittikaṃ homaṃ sthaṇḍile vā samācaretathātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi sruksruvasya ca lakṣaṇamgṛhītvā vibhajeddhastamātraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatā punaḥekāṃśena mitaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ saptabhāgamitaṃ mukhamkaniṣṭhāṅgulimānena sarpiṣo nirgamāya cavidadhīta bahistasyā ekāṃśenābhito'vaṭammekhalā mukhavedyoḥ syāt parito'rddhāṃśamānataḥṣaḍbhiraṃśaiḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgo vedyāḥ kūrmākṛtirbhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mukhasya pṛṣṭhabhāge'syāḥ saṃproktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ srucaḥdvāviṃśatyā daṇḍamānamaṃśairetasya kīrtitamaṃśadvayena nikhanet paṅke mṛgapadākṛtipūrvavacca sruvasyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtamsruksruvāṇāmabhāve tu prakārāntaramucyateathavāśvatthapatrābhyāṃ saṃkṣipte homakarmaṇisaptamaḥ prakāśaḥādau kuṇḍasya saṃskārānaṣṭādaśa ca kārayettenaiva tāḍanaṃ darbhairvarmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ matamhṛdayenāstramantreṇa samīkaraṇameva camārjanaṃ varmamantreṇa tataḥ kuryādvilepanamtrisūtrīkaraṇañcaiva hṛnmantreṇa prapūjayetcatuṣpathabhāgarūpaṃ nayanenākṣapāṭanamāhavanīyaṃ tato'nvāhāryaṃ dakṣiṇadeśataḥcatuṣṭayaṃ vā mūlena vīkṣaṇañca śarānunāprokṣaṇaṃ kavacenaiva saṃskārāśca samīritāḥaṅguṣṭamadhyamotsedhavālukāmayamaṇḍalamśodhanaṃ kārayet sthānaṃ vīkṣaṇādicatuṣṭayaiḥprādeśamātraṃ vijñeyaṃ mukundeśendrarūpiṇamrekhātrayaṃ tathā brahmavaivasvatendurūpakamrajastāsāṃ samuddhṛtya prokṣayet praṇavena tudhānyapiṣṭena vā madhye cūrṇena vā haridrayālikhitvā bālayā puṣpaṃ tanmadhye ca vinikṣipetmaṇḍūkaṃ pūjayedrūdramādhārakūrmaśūkarāna-pūrvāṃsteṣu koṇeṣu pīṭhasyopari pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: punastāreṇa mantrajño yogapīṭhaṃ yajettataḥyogapīṭhaṃ ṅenamo'ntaṃ pīṭhamantro'yamīritaḥkāmeśvarīṃ mahāprauḍhāṃ nīlendīvarasannibhāmśaktibījena kāmeśīṃ kāmeśaṃ sādhyamantrataḥaraṇīsambhavaṃ vāpi kṣiptaṃ svarṇādibhājaneathavā'nītamabhitaḥ sthāpayet kāṃsyabhājanetasmāt samānayet kiñcid vahnibījena yājakaḥprokṣayet kavacenaiva tathā-vaguṇṭhanaṃ caretdaśadigbandhanaṃ kṛtvā dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayetkūrcāstrābhyāñca nairṛtyāṃ kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajetśvāsamārgeṇa manuvit kavacena tato'rcayetcaitanyaṃ ṅe namo'ntaṃ syādanenotthāpayecchucimātmano'bhimukhaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktamaṇḍalāntaresarvajñājñāpaya svāhā vahniṃ prajvālayet sudhīḥimāñca jvālinīṃ mudrāṃ darśayet sādhakottamaḥsuvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvato mukhamkāmabījaṃ samuccārya vahnimūrtiṃ samarcayetkāmeśvaryā garbhadeśe vahnimanena bhāvayetjihvāyāṃ devatā nyasetsvaliṅgagudamūrddhāsya-nāsānetrāṅgake kramātcaturthyantāḥ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu yojayet kramaśaḥ sudhīḥagninā saha sarvatra manuvijjātavedasamviśvamukhaṃ devamukhameṣu sthāneṣu vinyasetvāmapāyau tasya deśe pārśvāṃśe kramato nyasetsvaliṅgagudamūrddhāsyanāsānetreṣu sarvataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bindunādakalāyuktā jihvāmantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥjihvāstāstrividhāḥ proktā guṇabhedena karmasubahurūpātirūpā ca sāttvike yāgakarmaṇirajoguṇasamuddiṣṭā rasanāḥ kāmyakarmasuetāḥ sapta prapūjyante krūrakarmasu mantribhiḥsvasvanāmasamābhāḥ syujihvāḥ kalyāṇaretasaḥarghyodakena cābhyukṣya madhyasthamekhalopariuttarāgraṃ paścime tu prāgagramuttare kramātasyopari sicet toyairmūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥprādakṣiṇyena sampūjyāsteṣu brahmādimūrtayaḥvaradābhayaśobhāḍhyaṃ suvarṇavarabhūṣaṇamtrinetramujjvalaṃ dhyāyedūrddhvamauliṃ jaṭādibhiḥlohitākṣa ca sarvānte karmāṇyatha ca sādhayatanmukhe rasanāṃ yajetpūrvoktamantrayogeṇa ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇaṃ yajetpunarvaiśvānaraṃ dhyātvā pūjayet sādhakottamaḥpraṇītāprokṣaṇīyugme jalapuṣpe vinikṣipetādāya vāmahastena dūrvayā mārjayet tridhāātmano dakṣiṇe bhāge sthāpayedāstare kuśepavitraṃ tatra saṃsthāpya kuryādīśamukhaṃ sudhīḥkṛtvā cāṅgārakaṃ vāyau ghṛtamadhye vinikṣipethṛdayena ca mantreṇa dyotanaṃ samudīritamaṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāntu tat pavitrañca dhārayettamagnau kṣepayedājyaṃ bālayā chābhimantrayetmekhalāsu ca sarvāsu dīpamālā niyojayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saprādeśaṃ darbhayugmaṃ granthiyuktaṃ ghṛte kṣipetiḍāṃ dakṣe piṅgalāñca suṣumṇāṃ madhyabhāgataḥjuhuyādagnaye svāhetyagnerdakṣiṇalocanejuhuyādatha somāya svāheti hṛdayāṇunājuhuyādagnīṣomābhyāṃ svāheti hṛdayāṇunājuhuyādagnaye sviṣṭikṛte svāheti tanmukheityagnernetravaktrāṇāṃ kuryādudghāṭanaṃ guruḥmahāvyāhṛtihomañca tārādyena caturhunetbhuvaḥpadād vāyave ca antarīkṣāya śabdataḥsvarādityacandramasau ṅentau nakṣapadāttataḥbhyasantaścaiva digbhyaśca mahate vahnivallabhābrahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe'bhyarcya vidhivat sādhakottamaḥidamagneḥ karomyetad garbhādhānamataḥ paramhutvā saptāhutīrevaṃ samidhaḥ kṣepaṇaṃ tathājātakarma samāpyātha nālāpanodanāya caoṃ kāmeśvara-kāmeśvarībhyāṃ svāheti ca nirvapetiṣṭadevasya nāmnā tu vahnernāma samācaretcūḍopanayanaṃ caiva samāvartanameva cavivāhañca śubhe kārye krūrakāryeṣu māraṇamnyāsakrameṇāṣṭamūrterhomaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥjuhuyādagnimantreṇa vauṣaḍantena sampadejuhuyācca caturvāraṃ samaste naiva tena tubhinnenaiva samastena tanmantraśca nigadyatepañcāntakaṃ binduyutaṃ ṅentaṃ gaṇapatiṃ tataḥme vaśamānaya svāhā viṃśatyantagajāntakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sāmānyaṃ sarvadevīnāṃ mukhametat samīritamvibhāvyāvāhayeddevīṃ śrīmattripurasundarīmājyena juhuyānmantrī vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ tvidamnāḍīsandhānamuddiṣṭametadāgamavedibhiḥsaṅkalpañca tataḥ kṛtvā kāmyahomaṃ samācaretjuhuyājjvalite vahnau saṃkhyāñca paritaścaretyadi kāmī bhaveccaiva śūdro'pi homakarmaṇivārāhītantrarājasya matametadudīritamuccāṭe vāyujihvāyāṃ madhyasthāyāntu māraṇevilvākṣaśīgrughaṭitaṃ māraṇoccaṭanādiṣutisro mudrāḥ smṛtā home mṛgī haṃsī ca kasturīmṛgī kaniṣṭhātarjanyau tyaktvā mudrātrayaṃ smṛtamyajñe śāntikakārye ca mṛgī haṃsī prakīrtitāśāntau vaśye tathā stambhe vidveṣoccaṭamāraṇebālābījairyathānyāyaṃ śrīvidyāṃ pūjayet tataḥghṛtena srucamāpūrya puṣpamagre nidhāya cayavarūpāṃ huned dhārāṃ jayaghoṣapuraḥsaraiḥātmārpaṇena manunā hunedaṣṭāhutiṃ kramātitaḥ pūrvamiti procya prāṇabuddhīti coccaretavasthāsu manaseti vācā ca karmaṇeti caśiṅā yat smṛtamityetad yaduktaṃ yat kṛtantathāṅe'ntāṃ samarpitaṃ tāraṃ tat sadātmā'rpaṇe manuḥabhyukṣya pūjayed vahniṃ gandhapuṣpādinā sudhīḥekaikāmāhutiṃ hutvā tattanmantreṇa deśikaḥanenāgniñca saṃprārthya kṣamasveti visarjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naimittike ca paridhīn nitye naiva ca saṃdahetiti śrīpūrṇānandaparamahaṃsaviracite śrītattvacintāmaṇau aṣṭamaḥ prakāśaḥatha prasaṅgād vakṣyāmi homadravyasya lakṣaṇammūḍhasyāpi ca mūkasya śilārūpasya nānyathāyoṣitaḥ sakalā vaśyā dāsībhūtā bhavanti hihutvā lakṣaṃ vaśīkuryād viṃśatiṃ dharaṇībhujāmmadhvaktakaravīraistu sāṅgaṃ bhūpaṃ vaśaṃ nayetpāṭalairyūthikākundaiḥ śatapatraiśca jātibhiḥsarvasaubhāgyamāpnoti buddhyā ca vākpatirbhavetraktotpalairjagad vaśyaṃ rājāno vaśagāḥ kṣaṇātśvetotpalaiḥ śriyaṃ vācaṃ labhate havanād dhruvamvakulasya phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ saubhāgyaṃ jāyate mahathavanānmaraṇañcaiva mantriṇā vijitaṃ bhavetprāpnoti mantrī mahatīṃ stambhayejjagatīmimāmsarve lokā vaśāstasya bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥdurgopasargaśamanaṃ palatrimadhuhomataḥkhecaro jāyate rātrau kṛtvā homaṃ catuṣpathemahārāṣṭraṃ mahādurgaṃ samastaṃ vaśamānayetāyurdhanamathā'rogyaṃ samṛddhirjāyate nṛṇāmdadhimākṣikayogeṇa saubhāgyaṃ dhanamāpnuyātvaśayedduṣṭalokāṃśca havanānnātra saṃśayaḥdadhnā'ṣṭaśatakaṃ hutvā'kālamṛtyuṃ vaśaṃ nayetmadhvājyaguggulenaiva rājendraṃ vaśamānayetrogahantā lokahantā mṛtyuhantā bhaved dhruvamtilājyahomamātreṇa sarvakarmāṇi sādhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: guggulasya ca homena sarvaduḥkhāni nāśayetraktacandanahomena vaśyā hi puruṣāḥ striyaḥkastūrīhavanānmantrī sarve vaśyā bhavanti hiśarkarāguḍahomena sarvakāryāṇi sādhayetghṛtapāyasahomena vaśīkuryānmahāgrahāntrailokyaṃ vaśamāpnoti dhānyavṛddhirbhavet kilapūrṇadāḍimbahomena vaśīkuryānmahāgrahānmātuluṅgaphalairhomāt kṣatriyā vaśagā dhruvamkuṣmāṇḍaphalahomena śūdrā vaśyā bhavanti hidrākṣāphalaiḥ siddhayo'ṣṭau lakṣahomānna saṃśayaḥvaśyāstu daśasaṃkhyātā bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥvaśyā viṃśatisaṃkhyātā bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥlakṣamātreṇa mantrajño rājatulyo bhaved dhruvamcatuḥsamudraparyantāṃ medinīṃ vaśamānayetikṣudaṇḍaiḥ sukhāvāptistadvaśā rājakanyakāḥpuṣpaṃ samagraṃ juhuyāt kamalenāpi puṣkalamśatasaṃkhyāstilāścaiva rājikāḥ śatasaṃkhyayācullukārddhaṃ tathā kṣīramannaṃ grāsamitaṃ bhavetmanaḥpriyaiśca khaṇḍaiśca phalairbhavati niścayātpanasaiḥ phalagarbhasthaiścūtairmadhuyutairhunetdrākṣāphalaṃ samastaṃ syānnāgaraṅgañca kharjuramguñjāsamānaṃ karpūraṃ kastūrī ghusṛṇaṃ tathāmanaḥpriyāṇi sarvāṇi phalāni havanāya caprakārāntaramucyatebhavanti karṣamāṇañca guḍaṃ palārddhamātrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātuluṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhā smṛtamtridhā khaṇḍaṃ phalaṃ vailvaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ dvidhāvrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syū raktamāṣā yavā apitintiḍībījamānāni marīcānyapi viṃśatiḥanukte tu havirdravye tilājyaṃ havirucyateathārimantratyāgasya vidhiḥ samyak pracakṣyateaśeṣaduḥkhanāśāya deśikaḥ pravaraṃ vidhimmaṇḍale sthāpayed vidvān pūrayettaṃ jalaiḥ śubhaiḥsakalīkṛtya saṃpūjyā'varaṇāni prapūjayethutvā vilomamantreṇa sarpiṣā gorapi dvijaḥvidikṣu dikṣu ca tathā vakṣyamāṇairmanukramaiḥnamastubhyaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ puṣpadhūpādikaṃ valim (1)gṛhāṇa puṣpadhūpādivalimenaṃ supūjitam (2)valiṃ dattaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ suprīto varado bhava (3)gṛhāṇa valipūjādi mayā bhaktyā niveditam (4)bhaktyā niveditāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā prītimāpnuhi (5)mayā prayuktaṃ vidhivad gṛhāṇa valimādarāt (6)puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ prītau bhavetāṃ varadau mama (7)pūjitaḥ puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ prāto bhava vibhūtaye (8)gṛhāṇa sarvavighnān me nivartaya namo'stu te (9)pūjitaḥ parayā bhaktyā bhava tvaṃ sukhado mama (10)mantreṇa viparītena puṣpa-dhūpopacārakaiḥtatastu prārthayed vidvān pūjitāṃ mantradevatāmtena me manasaḥ kṣobhaṃ vinivartaya sarvadātanotu mama kalyāṇaṃ pāvanī bhaktireva te
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalasopari saṃsthāpya bhaktyā paramayā punaḥsnāyāt pūjitakumbhasthatoyairmantramayaiḥ śubhaiḥtanmadhye mantrapatrañca nikṣipyātha prapūjayetnikṣipeddaśa viprāṃśca yathāśaktyā prapūjayetnaśyantyeva na sandehaḥ kramāccittaprasannatāmālinīvijayasyeti matametadudīritamnavamaḥ prakāśaḥsarvaśāstramayīṃ devīṃ sarvakāraṇarūpiṇīmbrahmaviṣṇubhavairvandyāṃ śrīmattripurasundarīmtatrādau pañcamī vidyā kathyate bhuvi durlabhānityā ca muktidā śuddhā sukhadā duḥkhanāśinīpṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśasambhavamtejo rudrasya rudrāṇī vāyurīśasya ceśvarīpañcadevātmakaṃ pañca pañcamī-pañcaśaktayaḥtṛtīyā bhagamālā ca turyā tripurasundarīnityā ca pañcamī śaktiḥ paraṃbrahmasvarūpiṇītasmāddevyāśca tadrūpamudayāstavivarjitamsthūlasūkṣmavibhedena paraṃbrahmasvarūpiṇīsaiva viśveśvarī devī vyāpakatvena saṃsthitāśambhunā cintyate sā tu tatprasādācchivo vibhuḥbrahmatvaṃ brahmaṇā prāptaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ viṣṇunā svayam(p. 285) surāsuramunīndrāṇāṃ mahattvaṃ tatprasādataḥso'pi cābhūt svayaṃ kartā śivatulyo mahāmuniḥatiguhyatamā vidyā brahmavidyaiva kevalāgurubhakto jitākṣaśca pañcamīṃ samupāsayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvadevamayī śuddhā sarvaśaktimayī śubhāpṛthivyāṃ mānavaḥ śreṣṭho yadi jānāti pañcamīmsa bhavet khecaro nityamabhyāsānnātra saṃśayaḥsa pūjyaḥ sarvalokeṣu sa devo na tu mānuṣaḥkalpanāśuddhabhāvena sarvasiddhiṃ labhettu saḥkāraṇānandarūpeṇa pañcamīṃ samupāsayetpañca kūṭaprakāreṇa trikūṭā vāgbhavāditaḥnaro lakṣaṃ japtvā suragurusamānaḥ sa bhavatikāmaṃ śambhusamīraṇendragirijābījaṃ krameṇoddharetśambhuṃ manmathaśakrasomasahitaṃ devīṃ krameṇoddharetrājaśrīcaraṇāravindayugalā pūrṇenduśuddhānanāpañcakūṭātmikā vidyā pañcapañcākṣarī bhavetjñātvā yat sādhayennityamasādhyamapi bhūtaleevaṃ kūṭatrayeṇāpi vidyā saubhāgyarūpiṇīdurlabhā sarvalokeṣu sarvasaubhāgyasundarījaptvā'nandamayo bhūtvā sarvakāmamupālabhetākarṣaṇakarī vidyā cittāhlādanakāriṇīmahābhogakarī vidyā mahāsiddhipradāyinīyasyā ārādhanaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtaleañjanaṃ guṭikādiśca yā yā vidyā sudurlabhāaṇimāsiddhayaḥ santi vaśyā bhavanti devatāḥdūrādeva palāyante darśanāt sādhakasya cajīvanmuktaḥ sādhakendraḥ kartā hartā bhaveddiviekākṣareṇa kathitaṃ brahmavidyaiva kevalamsā devī pañcamī vidyā sarvādhārasvarūpiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nānyat parataraṃ kiñcid vidyate bhuvanatrayesarvaṃ tat paramaṃ rūpaṃ tasyā eva na saṃśayaḥsahasraikapramāṇena kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtaleyogātmā sa bhavenmukto nānābhogena kevalamyasmai kasmai na dātavyā vidyā paramadurlabhādātavyā pañcamī vidyā putrāya prāṇadāya caparamānandanirvāhaṃ kuloḍḍīśe prakāśitamtadadhaḥ śakrabījantu yojayed bhuvaneśvarīmeṣā vidyā mahāvidyā dharmakāmārthamokṣadāaparañca pravakṣyāmi kulāmṛtamataṃ parameṣā guhyā parā jñeyā puruṣārthaphalapradāsārāt sārataraṃ kūṭaṃ śrīkrame tu prakāśitamindrabījaṃ śivaḥ paścānmṛgātmā tadanantaramvāgbhavaṃ pūrvamuditaṃ kāmarājaṃ trikūṭakamatiyatnena goptavyā mātṛmaithunavat sadāprabhutvaṃ śambhunā prāptaṃ yasyā dhyānaprasādataḥsākṣād brahmasvarūpaṃ hariharamunibhiḥ sevitaṃ sarvasāramgopyā sarvaiḥ prayatnādabhimataphaladā naiva vācyā parasminmātṛmaithunavannityaṃ gopayet sādhakottamaḥśrīkrame ca mahātantre śivena parikīrtitamkevalā citkalā nityā nityānandasvarūpiṇīaprakāśyā mahāvidyā gopanīyā prayatnataḥvaraṃ putraṃ dhanaṃ rājyaṃ deyaṃ neyaṃ kadācanatadā jñātvā kulīnāya śiṣyāya prāṇadāya calikhitvā darśayed bhūmau na ca karṇe prakāśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataḥ svātmaviśuddhyarthaṃ lakṣamekaṃ japed guruḥanyasaṃsmaraṇādduḥkhaṃ yoginīśāpamālabhetkimadhikam paraṃ sādhyamasyāḥ sarvatra yad bhavetanayā sadṛśaṃ jñānaṃ sarvatantreṣu durlabhamtṛtīyaṃ śaktikūṭaṃ syāttryakṣarī tripurā parāanayā sadṛśī vidyā nāsti lokatraye yataḥeṣā pañcadaśī devī saubhāgyaiṣā ca pañcamīeṣā tattvaparā jñeyā saptaviṃśākṣarī tathākāmakalā turīyā ca śaktistu sārddhamātṛkāekākṣareṇa kathitā brahmavidyaiva kevalājyotīrūpeṇa sā devī paraṃtejaḥsvarūpiṇīvarṇāni vividhānyeva tasyā bhedāni tattvataḥtasyā bhedānyanekāni tejāṃsi ca guṇāni casaiva viśveśvarī devī svataḥ kaivalyadāyinīsāmānyāḥ siddhirahitā jñātavyā deśikottamaiḥevameṣā samutpannā mahātripurasundarītasyā rūpañca taj jñeyaṃ jagad vyāpya vijṛmbhatenaro japtvā siddhaḥ prabhavati mahāmokṣapadavīmarihā siddhidā nityā trailokye cātidurlabhādatte ca siddhihāniḥ syāt kruddhā bhavati sundarīmanurvimṛṣya dātavyo jyeṣṭhaputrāya dhīmatetena vīryavatī vidyā bhāryā kulabadhūrivaśuddhā sarvatra vijñeyā sarvadoṣavivarjitāvāgbhavaṃ gaganaṃ hādyamuṣmā bhautikabindumānetattu vāgbhavaṃ kūṭaṃ sarvapakṣeṣu śobhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śukrātmā bhāskaro'nanto devarājaḥ śivastathāmanusargau tataḥ śaktirbhānurindro maheśvarīmantranirṇayatantre ca śivena parikīrtitāvāgbhavaṃ vijayā māyā brahmā śakraśca pārvatītato hādyaṃ manusargavibhūṣitamaṣṭādaśākṣarī vidyā mahātripurasundarīsarvānte haṃsasaṃyuktā tadā viṃśākṣarī bhavetmanunā sargavān bhṛguḥkāmabījaṃ lakṣmīrbhṛguḥ prajāpatiḥnārīṇāṃ mohinī devī jagatkāraṇarūpiṇībhago māyā tato brahmā śakrastu bhuvaneśvarībhuvaneśyā maheśaśca śaktirbrahmeśa indrakaḥbhuvaneśyā netramastraṃ śaktirmādana eva caeṣā parāpi vijñeyā tattvarūpā maheśvarīnāsti vidyā samā cāsyā balavīryasamanvitākāmendrau ca mahāmāyā vāgbhavaṃ kūṭamuttamamśaktikūṭaṃ śṛṇuṣva tatśaktiḥ kāmaḥ sahasrākṣo mahāmāyā tataḥ paramsavīryā siddhidā nityā vidyā sarvārthasiddhidābhairavaṃ bindumālī ca brahmā śakraḥ sureśvarīmahāmāyā vāgbhavañca mānmathaṃ sargavān bhṛguḥśaktikūṭaṃ likhettataḥbhṛgurbrahmā sahasrākṣo mahāmāyā tadantaramsaptaviṃśākṣarī vidyā mahātripurasundarīramate sakalāṃ nārīṃ japtvā yāti surālayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: manoḥ smaraṇamātreṇa vrajedbhagavataḥ padameṣā vidyā prayatnena guptā grantheṣu koṭiṣubhāṣitā śaṅkareṇaiva sālaṅkārā mahodayāgopanīyā prayatnena na deyā yasya kasyacitharo bhṛgurdivānātho vajradhṛg bhuvaneśvarīkāmabījadvayañcaiva vāgbhavaṃ ca humātmakamśaktikūṭamathocyatemahāmāyā tataḥ paścāddhaṃsabījaṃ tadantikebālābījatrayañcaiva jhiṇṭīśo bindumālinīpāśaḥ śaktirmādanañca śūnyendrau bhuvaneśvarīkāmarājamidaṃ puṇyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvadurlabhammahāvidyeśvarī paścād vidyā saṃhāriṇī bhaveteṣā sā sundarī vidyā śatrūṇāṃ prāṇanāśinīsthitirūpā mahāvidyā sādhakāya varapradāna cāsyāḥ sadṛśī kācit triṣu lokeṣu vidyatevahnibījaṃ tataḥ paścād bhautikena samanvitametattu vāgbhavaṃ kūṭaṃ sarvapakṣeṣu durlabhamprāṇau madanaśūnyau ca devarājaḥ sureśvarīsauḥkāraṃ śivaśaktī ca vahnibījaṃ manusvaramsargacandraṃ nādayuktaṃ śaktibrahmendramāyayā(p. 313) sṛṣṭirūpā mahāvidyā sārabhūtā mahodayāśivātmā tatparo vahnirbhautikenendunā yutaḥetattu vāgbhavaṃ kūṭaṃ kathitaṃ sarvadurlabhametajjaptvā mahābījaṃ kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtalevāgīśaṃ sparddhate vākyaiḥ sarvajñastu prajāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāgbhavaṃ mānmathaṃ bījaṃ sauḥkāraṃ bindumālinībrahmā śakraśca vahniśca māyārddhendusamanvitaḥetatkūṭasya māhātmyaṃ śatakoṭisuvistaramhelayā tridivaṃ prāpya modate śambhunā sahavāñchitaṃ labhate kāmaṃ satyameva na saṃśayaḥbālāyāḥ śaktikūṭañca śaktistu kamalāsanaḥśaktikūṭamidaṃ puṇyaṃ puruṣārthapravartakamna deyā kasyacit sthāne sugopyā durlabhā parābrahmā śivendrau śaktiśca mahāmāyā tataḥ parāeṣā pañcadaśī bhāṣā sākṣāt tripurasundarīevameṣā mahāvidyā mahātripurasundarībṛhacchīkramatantrasya matametadudīritamyasyā ārādhanenaiva kāmaḥ sarvāṅgasundaraḥsarvaśāstramayī vidyā sarvasaubhāgyasundarīśāktaśāmbhavabhedena kathayāmi sudurlabhāmdattvā māyāṃ tadante bhajati suragaṇo mantramenaṃ prasiddhamṛtuvarṇātmakaṃ kūṭaṃ kāmarājantu madhyamamevaṃ kūṭātmikā devī tryakṣarī tripureśvarījñeyā sā kīlitā vidyā siddhidā na hi bhūtaleetatkāraṇavṛttāntaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥāsīcca nagare nityaṃ bhikṣārthī vicareddvijaḥjalābhilāṣiṇaṃ vipraṃ nijagāda sarastaṭevilokya sahasā vipro natvā taṃ daṇḍadhāriṇamdattvāśīrvādaṃ sannyāsī bhūyo brāhmaṇamabravītmantraikaṃ kathayāmi tvāṃ snānaṃ kuru vidhānataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmapatre jalaṃ kṛtvā padmapuṣpeṇa cārcayayathā jñānavidhānena guruṇā kathito manuḥkartavyaṃ puṇyatīrtheṣu parvateṣu nadīṣu vābhūpatirbhūtale bhūtvā cānte svargaṃ gamiṣyasitapaḥsthāne tato gatvā punastaddharmamācaretekacittaḥ sadā bhūyo japenmantraṃ vidhānataḥanekakālaparyantaṃ na labdhvā vāñchitaṃ phalamna dṛṣṭvā kāryasampattiṃ mahāduḥkhī babhūva saḥetat kaṣṭaṃ samāsādya vadan vipro viṣādavānsārathirnāsti me'raṇye mahāduḥkhe'pyupasthitenirdayaḥ pārvatānātho nirdayā karuṇāmayīsa didṛkṣurvidhātāraṃ gahanaṃ vanamāviśatyakṣarākṣasakuṣmāṇḍa-ḍākinīgaṇasaṃvṛtāḥbalahīno vaṭurbhūtvābhartsayat kamalāsanamvaṭunā duḥkhitenāpi sarastenāvalokitamnānāvṛkṣataṭākrāntaṃ nānāpakṣivibhūṣitambrahmoddeśe tanuṃtyaktvā kṣipraṃ yāmi yamālayambrāhmaṇaṃ rūpamāsthāya gatavān viprasannidhaukastvaṃ kathaṃ vane cāsmin hetunā kena vāgataḥkutaḥ kamāgataḥ ko vā manuṣyo vātha dānavaḥavyaktacakṣuṣā vipraḥ pratyuttaraṃ dadāti saḥdvijasya vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā vākyamabhāṣataḥanekakālaparyantaṃ narasaṅgavivarjitaḥtvāṃ vilokya viśeṣeṇa madīyaṃ dahyate vapuḥetadduḥkhamabhiprāpya kathamatrāpi tiṣṭhasi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taduddeśe vadhaṃ kṛtvā yāsyāmi dharmaśāśvatamvṛthā'śā kriyate vipra yā na syāt pṛthivītaletiṣṭhanti sarvadā devāḥ kadācit svargaśāsaneidaṃ śarīramādāya gaccha tvaṃ nijaveśmanigaccha gaccha mahābhāga tūrṇameva nijālayamtadbhoktavyaṃ mayā sākṣāt kimetadvacanena vainivṛttirme tadā jñeyā anyathā nidhanaṃ kilaprapalāyya gatastasmād yatna devo maheśvaraḥpunaḥ paramayā bhaktyā nijagāda pitāmahaḥbrāhmaṇasya vadhenaiva vināśo me bhaviṣyatipratyuvāca vidhātāraṃ kiṃ vadhaṃ brūhi me dhruvamkenopāyena deveśa tadvadho na bhavenmayijagāmāvyaktarūpeṇa brāhmaṇasya ca sannidhaukathaṃ tyajasi dehaṃ tvaṃ kāntamatyantasundarammattaḥ śṛṇu viśeṣaṃ tvamutkaṭaṃ narakaṃ vrajetvicintyaitanmahādeva upaviśya punarvadanmāṃ vilokya mahāraṇye na dadāsyuttaraṃ kathamdevadevaṃ jagannāthaṃ tapasvirūpadhāriṇamakhilaṃ sarvavṛttāntaṃ kathitaṃ taddvijena tusadayaḥ pārvatīnātho brāhmaṇāya vaco'bravītgṛhītaduṣṭamantreṇa hanyate siddhiruttamāsamastaṃ brūhi bhagavan śṛṇomi tvatprasādataḥyadi tvaṃ priyamākāṅkṣī vipro'si paramārthataḥtadā matto manuṃ gṛhṇa bhuktimuktipradāyakambrāhmaṇāya susiddhā sā sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: (p. 324) evamukto vibhustasya antardhāno'bhavacca saḥlabhetābhīṣṭasiddhantu satyameva suniścitamvaraṃ gṛhāṇa vipra tvaṃ manasā vāñchitaṃ yathāvareṇātaḥpareṇāpi phalaṃ kiṃ me bhaviṣyatiadhunā bhūpatirbhūtvā rājyasaukhyamavapsyasiataḥ paraṃ manuṃ japtvā śacīpatirbhaviṣyasicaṇḍikāyāḥ prasādena sahasā sa nṛpo'bhavatlabhate vāñchitāṃ siddhiṃ mantrāt kāryaṃ na sidhyatikalpakoṭiśatenāpi siddhistasya na jāyatedaśamaḥ prakāśaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00086 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
